Rents increased on 13 properties, adding £0.5 million to total rental income. The property portfolio valuation at 30 September 2025 totalled £132.3 million, with a net initial yield of 6.5%, compared to £146 million at 31 March 2025 with a 6.3% yield. A new £15 million Revolving Credit Facility was arranged in August 2025 for five years, with interest at 1.7% over Base Rate. Only 3.3% of the company's share capital was tendered at 204p per share, costing £3.05 million. The average interest rate on VIP's debt is 4.5% with a 36% Loan to Value ratio.
